title: Switch to TikTok Before Making
tests: Tests whether a mid-plan platform change overrides the original aspect ratio while retaining the creative brief.

faults.what: The steam forms a thick, unusually regular serpentine ribbon rather than softer, dispersing wisps.

judge.summary: A cosy vertical coffee-and-rain animation matches the brief well, though the curling steam looks somewhat artificial.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is vertical 9:16, not widescreen.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames have a vertical 9:16 composition.

must_haves.item: A coffee cup sits on a windowsill with visible rain outside.
must_haves.why: A cup of dark coffee rests on a wooden windowsill, with droplets on the glass and rain streaks outside.

must_haves.item: Steam visibly curls upward from the cup.
must_haves.why: A prominent curling steam plume rises from the coffee and changes shape across the frames.

must_haves.item: The scene has a cosy illustrated appearance.
must_haves.why: Warm amber wood and cup lighting contrast with the cool rainy exterior in a softly stylized, illustrated scene.

must_haves.item: The video lasts approximately 6 seconds and contains no text or audio.
must_haves.why: The supplied clip information identifies a six-second duration, and no text is visible, but audio cannot be verified from still frames.
